title: AdminCommon
description: Shared definitions for the operator control-plane contracts (admin v1, PRP-37). Definition library only: it declares no root instance shape and is never validated against directly, so it has no examples. No definition here can hold a credential value (A7): credentials appear only as a credential-reference.schema.json document.

schema_version.description: Contract version of the document, major 1 with additive minor revisions (ADR-0004).

admin_kind.description: Kind of a versioned operator configuration document (AdminConfigDocument.kind). Each kind's body is validated in core by ADMIN_KIND_MODELS (PRP-65).

config_version.description: Monotonic version of an operator configuration document, incremented on every accepted write.

reason_code.description: Machine reason code in snake_case, never free text (free text could carry names, UPNs or secrets into the audit trail).

principal_id.description: Canonical pseudonymous principal id minted by the PRP-06 pseudonymizer: cloud:customer:entra:(person|principal):p-<64 hex>. Never a UPN, email address or raw directory object id.

customer_id.description: Customer segment of the canonical id grammar (the tenant deployment).

cloud.description: Azure cloud boundary. Government data is never bridged to Commercial.

canonical_id.description: Canonical id cloud:customer:source:type:id (PRP-01 clarification 7). Grammar owned by catalog/v1; duplicated here as a pattern so admin v1 has no cross-area dependency.

domain_id.description: Canonical Domain id (type segment 'domain'). No wildcard or all-domains form exists.

record_id.description: Identifier of a record inside a policy or configuration document (assignment, grant, budget, item).

display_name.description: Human-readable label shown in the console. Not an identity attribute: never a person's name, UPN or email.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC (Z suffix required).

etag.description: Opaque optimistic-concurrency token. A mismatch on write returns the stale_version error.

role.description: Platform role (NS-08). admin and security_auditor are privileged and always time-bound.

grant_permission.description: Permission a resource-scoped grant may carry (mirrors scope/v1 resource_grant).

decimal_amount.description: Non-negative decimal string, up to 18 integer and 12 fractional digits; no exponent, no float.

https_url.description: HTTPS URL with no query string, fragment or userinfo (so no SAS or signed URL can be stored).

cost_tags.description: Cost allocation tags, the same grammar as cost/v1 CostRecord.tags (#190): at most 16 entries, keys lowercase ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,62}$, values 1 to 128 characters. The reserved key cost_center uses the catalog/v1 Grant cost_center pattern. The generated Pydantic model keeps the key and value bounds but not the entry count or the cost_center rule (ADR-0004 projection); both are checked by tests/contracts/validators.py::validate_cost_tags.

doc_path.description: Repository-relative documentation path (docs/...md), optionally with an anchor.
